_comment: Example MCP server configs for anycode-v2. Remove _comment keys and fill in real values. Supported transports: command (stdio). GitHub uses docker (github-mcp-server); gdrive uses npx; roblox-studio points at a local community server bridge.

github._comment: Create a fine-grained personal access token at github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens then paste it into the env value.

gdrive._comment: Requires OAuth credentials per @modelcontextprotocol/server-gdrive docs (GDRIVE_* env).

roblox-studio._comment: Community Roblox Studio MCP bridges pair a Studio plugin with a local server process; point args at that bridge's entrypoint.
